meta.title: Social lifestyle
meta.question: How liberal are Poles on abortion, gay rights and other moral questions?
meta.measure: Average position on social lifestyle questions, from 0 (liberal) to 10 (conservative)
meta.anchor: The average of three issue trends (abortion; gay and lesbian rights; euthanasia, in vitro, divorce and contraception), each pooled from the questions that ask about it, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.
